note: Before 1750, maps drew longitudes about 15% too wide or too narrow; after 1750, about 4%. Places over 6,000 km from where a map was printed were also misplaced 1.39 times as far east-west as north-south, against 0.98 within 500 km. After 1850 a small excess remains on every map, in two independent volunteer tools; whether it follows the page or the compass is still open.
